hooks.name: pkstack-goal-tripwire-advisory
hooks.description: Disabled advisory Stop probe. It reports active goal state but is never the /pkstack-verified-goal loop or a blocking control.

action.command: if [ -x .pkstack/bin/projectctl ]; then .pkstack/bin/projectctl goal tripwire --output json; else printf '%s\n' '{"pkstack":"tripwire-unavailable","display_name":"PKStack","expanded_name":"Poteto Kiro","power_id":"pkstack"}'; fi
